query: Consider the Non-Disclosure Agreement between NREL and Another Company; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold: d. The obligations of confidentiality set forth in Section 2., above, will survive termination of this Agreement until the end of the Confidentiality Period.
rag_answer: Yes. The document states that the confidentiality obligations set forth in Section 2 survive termination of the Agreement until the end of the Confidentiality Period, which is defined as three years from the Effective Date.
